decisions: _snake is read by all four domains (items, abilities, runes, stats), so leaving it in the residue is a back-edge from atomizer_abilities. It moves to atom_spelling.py with _stat_unit: both translate a cached data spelling into the atom contract's spelling, one an id fragment and one a unit, and that is the one home three domains read.

modules.docstring: How a cached name and stat field are spelled in the atom contract: id fragment and unit.
The ability domain: champion slot to effect to leveling modifier, plus a row's prose values.
